title: ever BRISTOL|Glitter Long Sleeve V-Neck A-Line Midi Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
Shine with effortless grace in this glittery A-line midi dress, perfect for wedding guests. Featuring long sleeves and a deep V-neckline, this dress combines elegance with a touch of glamour. The flattering A-line silhouette and sparkling fabric make it ideal for formal celebrations and special evenings. Comfortable yet stylish, it’s designed to help you feel confident and radiant throughout the event. Pair it with statement earrings and heels for a memorable ensemble.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Above knee.


Sleeve Style: Long sleeves.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises sequin.


Stretch: Fabric is low stretch.
